logs: S1-server: building team listing and runtime switch

S1-server: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS 31 tests added, 570/570 green (baseline 539), `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, full suite run 3x consecutively with no flake (31.5-32.5s). Red step confirmed for every group before implementing: index.test.ts 8 failed on "listTeamSummaries is not a function"; http.test.ts 7 failed (404 on the unrouted paths, 409 on the read-only one); index.wiring.test.ts 8 failed while the 2 pre-existing ones passed. Breakdown: index.test.ts +10 (listing builder against a temp teams root, plus 2 for fencedSink), index.wiring.test.ts +8 (real server via tsx: switch lands, nothing of A survives + re-asserted 400ms later, round trip restores A's history, no-op with no empty-roster blink, both 404s, race, --read-only, listing), http.test.ts +7 (no filesystem — every status code plus the read-only exemption), http.security.test.ts +1 (CSRF gates front the select route), store.test.ts +1 (named->named replay round trip).
